title: autoSpectra: Soil Spectral Modeling, Visualization and Prediction
description: An R package and Shiny application for predicting soil physical and chemical properties from diffuse reflectance spectra. Supports VisNIR (350–2500 nm) and MIR (600–4000 cm⁻¹) spectral domains. Provides four model families trained on the Open Soil Spectral Library (OSSL) v1.2: a masked soilVAE that is sensor-agnostic via spectral-dropout augmentation and per-mask SNV, and a Cubist + PCA(120) baseline replicating the methodology of Safanelli et al. (2025, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0296545). Both families share SNV preprocessing, log1p target transforms for skewed properties, 10-fold cross-validation with refitting, applicability-domain checks (Q-statistic for Cubist, Mahalanobis on the latent space for soilVAE) and conformal prediction intervals. Covers 34 OSSL Level-1 harmonized soil properties. OSSL data are not redistributed: they are downloaded at run time from the official OSSL storage bucket into a user-local cache, and published model archives are audited to contain only model parameters and aggregate statistics.
notes: Data used by this package: Open Soil Spectral Library (OSSL) v1.2, available under CC-BY 4.0 at https://docs.soilspectroscopy.org. Spectral preprocessing uses the prospectr R package (Stevens & Ramirez-Lopez, 2014). Predictive models are soilVAE asymmetric autoencoders implemented via Keras/TensorFlow.
